daily_summary: 本日变更是一次 main-dev 向 main 的同步，主体由三块构成：(1) DynamicCVPipeline/ssbuffer 的 Cube-Vector 流水线重构——引入控制流图(ControlFlowGraph)与 SCC 分析、新增 SplitMatmul pass 为 MNE(可能不执行)的 matmul L0C 复用链拆分并加计数守卫、把 split-if 相关逻辑移除/延后、UB usage 优化扩展到 scf.if 区域并修复 loop-carried backedge 权重、PointerCast 常量地址别名分析；(2) TLA DSL 能力扩展——新增 vabs/vnot/vrelu/vabsdif/vexpdif 一元与融合算子、pand/por/pxor/pnot/psel/vcmps/tail_mask/vcvt/vmull/pset 谓词与转换接口、mmad 的 transpose_a 与 real_m/k/n 实际尺寸支持、subview 视图与 offset 保持的 reshape，并把 DMA/Cube 接口补全参数文档；(3) 大量 TLA 单测（3-in-1 三阶段 IR/编译/精度）与新的 MLIR FileCheck 用例，同时把 gemm_basic_v2/gemm_bias_v2 合并回 v1 命名。整体是后端编译流水线正确性与 TLA 前端表达能力的双重增强，并显著扩张测试覆盖面。
test_impact_summary: 当日变更几乎每一块都自带测试：C++ pass 侧新增了 merge_small_block_inline_fill、ub_usage_opt_if_regions、ub_usage_opt_yield_cycles、plan_vector_block_scf_backedge、split-matmul 系列、pointer_cast 地址别名等 MLIR lit 用例；TLA 侧为每个新算子补齐了 3-in-1 单测与 host-only 前端契约测试，并新增 subview/reshape 的精确别名校验、mmad 转置与实际尺寸测试。测试策略上属于“变更与看护同步落地”，且覆盖到了 IR 结构、编译产物、NPU 数值三层。需要注意的风险点：一是 MNE/SplitMatmul 涉及 `ssbuffer.*` 新属性(kMNEStore0/kCoupledMatmulAndStore/kMatmulAtLeastOnceHint)与 SSBuffer 地址段 2560-3072 分配，现有端到端 DynamicCVPipeline_ut 是否联动回归需确认；二是 gemm_basic/gemm_bias 重命名后旧用例的引用（CI 清单、README、其他用例 import）是否残留；三是 vcvt 的 unsigned 方向明确只做了 builder 未做数值验证，属已知未看护区；四是 fixpipe/load_store 用例把原本“静默跳过”改成 pytest.skip 或新增 block 同步，需确认设备侧仍能通过。

commits.comment: 一次性同步 main-dev 到 main，76 个文件、+8414/-899，涵盖四条主线。其一，DynamicCVPipeline（ssbuffer）重构：新增 Common/ControlFlowGraph.{h,cpp} 以操作/Phi 为节点、Data/Yield/DeadResultExit 为边的局部依赖图，并提供基于 Tarjan 的 SCC 组件（含 entryOps/inputOperands/outputResults 边界信息），供 SplitMatmul 识别 L0C 累加器复用链；新增 StandardizeOp/SplitMatmul.cpp，把 may_not_exec 的 matmul 链的 C 初始值置零并在链尾加回，插入 per-matmul MNE 计数器（SSBuffer 2560-3072 地址段）与 scf.if 守卫，并打上 kMatmulAtLeastOnceHint/kCoupledMatmulAndStore 等属性；删除 AnalyzeSplitIf 并把 CloneCubeDepInIf/SplitIfByBlockId 两个 pass 从 ComputeBlockOpt 中改到 pipeline 末尾；OpClassifier/PlanCubeBlock 增加对 kMNEStore0/kCoupledMatmulAndStore 的 CUBE 归属；UBUsageOpt 把循环携带依赖建模下沉到 getLoopCarriedDefOp，支持嵌套 scf.if、修复双权重 SSA/backedge、并加环检测与 WHILE_LOOP_LIMIT 防死循环；MemoryEffectsTracker 增加基于 hivm.pointer_cast 常量地址区间的别名判定（按字节区间、处理动态 shape 与 subview）。其二，TLA DSL：simd.py 增加 vabs/vneg(带 mask/mode)/vnot/vrelu/vsqrt(mask/mode/precision)/vabsdif/vexpdif 及 vand/vmuls/vmula/vmadd/vaxpy/vln/pand/por/pxor/pnot/psel/vcmps/tail_mask/vmull/pset/vcvt，并在 _OP_ELEM_SUPPORT 中显式声明每算子的 dtype 契约；tla_builder.cc 增加 create_simd_preg_binary/unary、create_simd_vmull、vcvt 的 s2f/u2f/f2s/f2u 与 round/sat/part 属性规则、mmadL1 的 a_transpose 与 real extent、以及大量 passthrough；cube.py 的 mmad 增加 transpose_a 与 real_m/k/n（转置后校验归约维、real extent 需为 16 的倍数且不超过上界、acc 必须与实际尺寸匹配）；view.py 新增 subview(buf, offsets, sizes, strides) 并让 reshape 保留 offset；dma.py/alloc.py 补齐各族接口的 docstring。其三，测试：新增约 30 个 tla_ut/simd 算子 3-in-1 用例、cube/mmad.py 与 mmad_frontend_contract.py、vector/subview.py 与 view_frontend_contract.py，以及 9 个 MLIR lit 文件。其四，把 gemm_basic_v2/gemm_bias_v2 重命名合并为 gemm_basic/gemm_bias，并把 fixpipe 测试补上 BLOCK 同步、load_store 用 scope.vector 包裹且改成 pytest.skip。潜在风险：(a) SplitMatmul 的 MNE 计数器依赖 SSBufferManager 的独立地址段，与既有 valueToAddrMap 分配是否冲突需确认；(b) 属性在 RemoveAttributes 中新增清理项，需保证下游 pass 消费时机正确；(c) mmad 的 real extent 与 acc 形状强绑定，现有测试若用旧的非紧凑 L0C 会报错；(d) vcvt 的 f2u/u2f 明确未数值验证；(e) 删除 AnalyzeSplitIf 后回滚策略改由 SplitMatmul 承担，行为语义有变。

test_impact.reason: 变更同时修改了 LLVM/MLIR pass 行为、TLA 前端 API 与大量测试文件本身：新增 SplitMatmul/ControlFlowGraph/UBUsageOpt if 区域/MemoryEffectsTracker 别名等 MLIR 行为需要 lit 用例看护（已新增）外，还需确认 DynamicCVPipeline_ut 的 mlir_diff 端到端是否覆盖新的 kMNEStore0/kCoupledMatmulAndStore 路径；gemm_basic/gemm_bias 由 v2 合并回 v1 并删除 v2 文件，需检查 CI 清单/README/其他 import 是否仍引用 *_v2；fixpipe 与 load_store 用例的 skip/同步策略有变，需在真实 A5 环境复核通过率；vcvt 的 unsigned 方向、以及 mmad real extent 与旧 acc 形状兼容性需要额外用例或明确记录。

* [ascend](feat) add TLA SIMD unary and fused arithmetic ops

Add vabs, vnot, vrelu, vabsdif and vexpdif interfaces, upgrade vneg/vsqrt with mask/mode support, and add dtype/mask/tail coverage under tla_ut/simd. Keep vexpdif f32 as the validated contract and omit the expdif alias.

* [ascend](style) format TLA SIMD tests

Apply the repository yapf configuration to the new TLA SIMD test files and frontend contract tests.

---------

Co-authored-by: xiwei <xiwei4@huawei.com>

* [TLA](feat) Add subviews and mmad transpose-a (#2924)

* [Triton][TLA] feat: extend MMAD and buffer views

Motivation: Attention kernels need transpose-A MMAD and bounded actual
tile extents, while compact tail buffers need a general aliasing view
that preserves offsets through reshapes.

Design: Forward transpose-A to HIVM, validate actual MMAD dimensions,
and expose rank-preserving memref subviews. Preserve source offsets in
contiguous reshape result types. Add three-stage TLA unit tests and
frontend contract coverage with focused API documentation.

Risks: Non-square transpose-B calls now validate transposed dimensions.
Actual extents require a matching compact L0C accumulator. Dynamic
subview offsets remain the caller's responsibility to keep in bounds.

Assisted-by: AI

* [Ascend](docs) document TLA DMA and Cube interfaces

Document parameter types, layouts, defaults and current restrictions for the assigned DMA, allocation, MMAD and CTRL interfaces. Include their immutable parameter configurations without changing executable behavior.

* [Ascend](fix) synchronize TLA Fixpipe test writeback

Wait for Cube-produced UB data before Vector writeback: use PIPE.F after Fixpipe and PIPE.MTE1 after L12UB. Restrict the single-target UB store to sub-block 0 while both AIVs join the block handshake.

Check the handoff in lowered IR and validate all twelve configurations with three random seeds. The unmodified test reproduces four accuracy failures; the corrected test passes all 36 IR, compilation and runtime checks on Ascend950 with the existing main-dev wheel.

* [Ascend](fix) scope DMA load-store tests to Vector cores

Wrap load/store DMA operations in an explicit Vector scope so the current A5 backend can identify and lower the pure AIV module. Assert the Vector scope marker in the lowered IR.

Restore PadNull and atomic ADD/MAX/MIN accuracy checks, which pass exactly with the current main-dev wheel. Report the two remaining nonempty-padding cases with pytest.skip rather than returning and counting unexecuted checks as passed. Full DMA validation: 97 passed, 2 skipped; direct padding probes still reproduce incorrect output.

* [Ascend](test) promote Cube GEMM v2 tests

Replace the legacy gemm_basic and gemm_bias tests with their explicit DMA implementations. Remove the v2 files and rename kernel symbols and output labels while preserving IR, binary compilation and accuracy checks.

* [ascend](feat) TLA: add 16 Vec-SIMD affinity interfaces

First batch of tla.simd Vec-SIMD affinity interfaces with builder
support and tla_ut 3-in-1 precision tests:

  vand, vmuls, vmula, vmadd, vaxpy, vln,
  pand, por, pxor, pnot, psel, vcmps, tail_mask, vmull, pset, vcvt

Details:
- tla_builder.cc: new create_simd_preg_binary/create_simd_preg_unary
  (ave.hir.preg.and/or/xor/not), create_simd_vmull (ave.hir.mull),
  "and"/"ln" kinds for the generic binary/unary dispatchers, and a
  vcvt rework covering s2f/u2f/f2s/f2u with the ISA part/rnd/sat
  attribute rules from the op verifiers.
- builder.py: allowlist the three new builder methods for the unified
  builder.
- simd.py: the interfaces plus PAT/ROUND/PART enums; vaxpy composes an
  unmasked vmuls followed by a masked vadd, tail_mask composes
  vci(0) ULT broadcast(value), psel reuses the i1 vsel path, pset
  exposes the full ave.hir.pge pattern set.
- unittest/tla_ut/simd/: 16 test files following the 3-in-1 convention
  (IR assertions, compile artifacts, NPU numerics against torch
  references), 45 tests in total.

Verified: a full tla_ut/simd pytest run shows zero regressions against
the dev daily baseline (the 22 pre-existing failures are identical
with and without this change and are tracked separately).
